prompt:
Warm editorial storybook illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette. Picture-book register for adults. NEVER comic, NEVER cartoon, NEVER flat vector, NEVER photoreal, NEVER neon, NEVER 3D or CGI or Pixar, NEVER glossy plastic. Use the first reference ONLY for the illustration STYLE. The second reference is the SAME OBJECT this is a close-up of: reproduce its exact design, proportions, colours and page symbols faithfully. The third reference is the book's canonical look.

A TIGHT CLOSE-UP CROP filling the frame, on the left portion of that same object. The whole background is one plain flat warm cream field, empty edge to edge.

Show the place where the open book meets the long horizontal shaft. The book's SPINE lies along the shaft and IS the shaft: one continuous unbroken cream piece flowing left to right through the frame and out both edges, with the book's covers and pages fanning UPWARD from it like a butterfly opening along a hinge. Spine and shaft are the same object, the same material, with no break, no seam, no collar, no ring, no circle, no wheel, no bracket, no bolt, no screw, no gear between them. The pages glow softly warm and carry two or three tiny abstract symbols only: a small heart, a small open hand, a small balance-scale.

Warm, quiet, precise, gentle. No padlock, no chain, no keyhole, no red. No people, no hands, no figures. No landscape, no horizon, no sky. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words anywhere.

READABLE SURFACES FACE THEIR READER: any book, page, letter, scroll or sign a character is reading or writing faces THAT CHARACTER, never the camera. Compose over-the-shoulder or from behind so the surface genuinely faces them. Any handwriting is abstract handwriting-like line work with NO real readable letters.

NO USER INTERFACE ANYWHERE: no windows, menu bars, buttons, icons, toolbars, panels, form fields, cursors, floating rectangles or screenshot-like elements. Screens carry only soft glow or vague painterly shapes.
